en.about_p: Daddy Mi is a bilingual creative brand. We make devotionals, original music and videos with AI assistance — the voices and singing are AI-generated; the topics, scripts and review are our human team's work, and we label it plainly. One principle guides everything: be honest, be creative, and serve people.
